module_v15.name: Genealogy / Temporal Directionality
module_v15.goal: Test whether the reconstructed structural lineage exhibits ordered temporal/genealogical directionality across frozen historical and final canonical states, rather than merely generic similarity or shared surface form.
hard_rules: Do not use filesystem timestamps as the sole genealogy signal.
Do not infer authority from file existence alone.
Preserve original, corrected, negative, development, and final branches as distinct states.
Do not collapse F1 R1-R5 into F1 final.
Do not collapse V11 original into V11 clean.
Any lineage/directionality result must compare explicitly frozen states.
Surface terminology and RSOS names must not be required for the primary structural test.
Earlier negative or null outcomes must remain visible in adjudication.
No post-result threshold tuning is allowed for confirmatory contrasts.

module_v16.name: Population-Scale External Confirmation
module_v16.goal: Confirm population separation/rarity against frozen external population evidence while preserving F2-A, BR0, F2-B, WF1-B, and WF2 as methodologically distinct records.
hard_rules: F2-A remains an incomplete historical sub-run and is not promoted to final authority.
F2 BR0 remains a recovery run and is not substituted for F2-B.
F2-B corrected rarity and EXP-011 external population results remain separate authorities.
No claim of zero external reproduction is permitted.
Population estimates must identify tested representation, corpus, matching/control regime, and denominator.
Technical parsing/copy failures are not scientific negatives.
No broad C:\RSOS recursive input discovery is permitted.
Only Phase 8H frozen canonical references may enter confirmatory execution.
